title: Turn a whole-file audio decoder into a bounded streaming component

definition.title: Turn a whole-file audio decoder into a bounded streaming component
definition.source_excerpt: Construct valid independent miniature audio files for qualified whole-file browser decoding, then assemble correctly trimmed PCM on one clock. Start with lossless independent FLAC regions.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
definition.minimum_probe: Prerequisite-only first: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route. If absent, record HOLD_ENV; if present, decide whether the small probe is warranted. Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.

definition.primary_metric: Correct additional admitted source/destination capability; otherwise full startup and CPU/resource cost.
definition.scope_contract: Configuration and ordered codec payloads where copy is intended; requested frames/audio/timeline/features at the declared output boundary.
definition.negative_control: Alter one admission-critical configuration, remove a required dependency, or preserve video while making selected audio unsupported. Candidate must reject or use a declared fallback.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop before a new demuxer, player, codec build family or delivery service is needed. Record precisely which next implementation would unlock the screen.
